title: Concept: OS command execution via child_process.exec (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, child_process.exec executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (child_process.execFile with an args array) are javascript-specific.
applicability: javascript codebases that launch external processes through child_process.exec; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
